_about: Bukayo Saka's penalty for his hat-trick, England 6-4 France, World Cup third-place play-off, Miami, 18 July 2026. Penalty after Malo Gusto fouled Djed Spence; it made it 5-3 (theScore; Wego/ITV for the hat-trick). Kits: England white home, France blue home with white shorts (both home kits from the nation-kits file; the kits worn on the day are assumed). Keeper Maignan assumed; his kit colour is assumed.
